title.en: An Act Creating the Barrio of New Canipo in the Municipality of Taytay, Province of Palawan
title.orig: An Act Creating the Barrio of New Canipo in the Municipality of Taytay, Province of Palawan

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1965/ra_4256_1965.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The sitio of Capalpalan in the Municipality of Taytay, Province of Palawan, is hereby converted into a barrio of said municipality to be known as Barrio New Canipo.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 19, 1965.
